headline: Zoning hearings on additions, a garage rebuild, and an indoor pickleball court complex at several addresses.
summary: The board will review continued and new applications for special permits and variances at properties including 103 Essex Ave., 21 Walnut St., 36 Whittemore St., 14R Becker Circle, and 1 Banner Hill Wy. It will also discuss rules, regulations, and fees for comprehensive permits.
items: Approve Chair to sign decisions for 22 Calder St., 47 Ye Olde County Rd., 67 Middle St., and 29 Flume Rd.
Continued application: Kayla and Peter Cannavo, special permit and/or variance for addition at 103 Essex Ave., Map 218, Lots 4&5, R-20 zoning district
Continued application: Jamie and Benjamin Cevelo, special permit and/or variances for addition to home and accessory structure at 21 Walnut St., Map 121, Lot 55, R-20 zoning district

Continued application: 36 Whittemore St LLC, special permit and/or variance for change of use and reduction in off-street parking to construct indoor pickleball court complex at 36 Whittemore St., Map 36, Lot 14, GI zoning district
New application: Jane and William Dobson, special permit and/or variance to exceed maximum building height for accessory structure at 14R Becker Circle, Map 234, Lot 56, R-20 zoning district
New application: David and Jacquelyn Bell, special permit and/or variance to demolish and reconstruct attached garage at 1 Banner Hill Wy., Map 78, Lot 31, R-10 zoning district
Board discussion: review rules, regulations, and fees for MGL c. 40B, S 21 Comprehensive Permits
location: Kyrouz Auditorium, City Hall, 2nd Floor, 9 Dale Avenue, Gloucester, MA 01930
